title: Visualizing Uncertainty-to-Action Composition for Human Oversight
abstract: arXiv:2608.16428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems often disclose uncertainty, yet they rarely make clear what response that uncertainty should trigger. Most uncertainty visualizations encode uncertainty in model outputs, leaving users to discern the most appropriate course of action. A second region of the design space--uncertainty in the decision process itself, including how multiple uncertainty conditions compose into an oversight response-- remains comparatively underexplored. We address this gap with two coupled contributions. First, we introduce an uncertainty-to-action binding framework that composes multiple uncertainty conditions into a single oversight response under a precedence policy with a contextual safety modifier. That response concerns whether and how an AI-supported decision may proceed, not the substantive domain decision itself. Second, we present ActionCue, a process-transparency visualization that renders that composition explicit

translated_title: 可视化不确定性到行动的组合以支持人类监督
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16428v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人工智能系统通常披露不确定性，但很少明确这种不确定性应触发何种响应。大多数不确定性可视化将不确定性编码在模型输出中，让用户自行判断最合适的行动方案。设计空间的第二个区域——决策过程本身的不确定性，包括多个不确定性条件如何组合成监督响应——相对未被充分探索。我们通过两项相互关联的贡献来解决这一空白。首先，我们引入了一个不确定性到行动绑定框架，该框架在带有上下文安全修饰符的优先级策略下，将多个不确定性条件组合成单一的监督响应。该响应涉及AI支持的决策是否以及如何进行，而非实质性的领域决策本身。其次，我们提出了ActionCue，一种过程透明可视化工具，使该组合过程明确可见。
tldr: 本文提出不确定性到行动绑定框架和ActionCue可视化，将多个不确定性条件组合成明确的监督响应，提升AI决策过程的人类监督透明度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an uncertainty-to-action binding framework and ActionCue visualization that compose multiple uncertainty conditions into explicit oversight responses, enhancing transparency for human oversight of AI decision processes.
